floating.title: @dannysir/floating-components
floating.description: A VS Code-style panel tree. Drag a panel header onto another panel to reorder, drag the borders to resize. Try the toolbar to split, add, or reset.

toolbar.noSelection: Click a panel to select it

jste.title: @dannysir/js-te
jste.description: A Jest-style test framework. The real library runs on top of Node.js native loader hooks, but this page only mimics the core API (describe/test/expect/fn/test.each) in a tiny browser runner. Module mocking (mock()) can't be simulated in the browser, so we just show the code.
jste.mockBanner: This example uses Node.js module mocking (mock()), which can't run in the browser — code is shown for reference only.
